note: PR 1: the deck toolbar's All · Shopping · Stats · Notes bar on SegmentedSwitch (a tablist, accent tone) and By type / By role beside the sort (a radiogroup, neutral tone). Needs a server with DECK_STATS_ENABLED and DECK_NOTES_ENABLED set to 'true', and SWITCH_DECK a deck the signed-in account owns (local-dev: d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000cafe). The By role row presses the radio; the grouping persists in localStorage (`the99:deck-grouping`), so the row after it opens on By role too, which is the persistence check.
